event.name: c. 3000 BC: The prehistoric monument at Bryn Celli Ddu in Anglesey was built

r2SourceEvidence.date_precision: approximate; the single 3000 BCE gameplay slot is a reference point, not a proven exact year
r2SourceEvidence.location_precision: modern monument reference point, not site boundaries
r2SourceEvidence.review_note: The Wikipedia article places a henge around 3000 BCE but describes its passage tomb as much later. A peer-reviewed 2010 study models passage-tomb construction between 3074 and 2956 calibrated BCE. The event deliberately refers only to a prehistoric monument and does not assert either phase chronology as certain. The paper's model is a date range, not proof of construction in 3000 BCE. The 20 km radius is a gameplay setting, not a mapped extent. A 2026-10-28 scan of indexed event and site names found no Bryn Celli Ddu row; differently named records can still overlap.
